title: Health Analytics Phone in Chrome Blinds
whatItIs: A rounded panel where a phone showing a Health Analytics heart rate chart is tilted in the centre of a white space framed by converging grey chrome slats above and below.
whatItMeans: The slats converge toward the phone like a lens, adding motion and drawing the eye to the screen.

White centre space around the device
